I walk here, i see place, same place i been walking over 30ys everyother week if not month occasionally.  

But i dont relate to it anymore,  im no longer connected to it, the atmosphere looks different in a same way, people roads buidling i only recognize by mental idea that i havent moved en neither has someone yet tell me home is wrong place. Remove those en basically im lost.

Things i see imfront of my eyes seem nothing more than a rosy picture like walking in a pucture whos contents are animated not living, i see them but i cant sense them even as they are close en pass by me.

Sometimes i look at this things en wonder has me chnaged too much or has things around me chnaged also , so we both chnaged. Spirit world is like this but theres sense of connection, its thin and mostly i never notice but when im here en recalling and analyzing the adventure of then.


More as i was looking at this, its not like i never had this feeling or perception of disconnects but mostly there always been someking of connection rather than a mirrage full. 

Most important thing was now im this capable en im interfereing in existance , but looking at current sensing the question become, what am i doing, why am i rewriting rules of things that i nolonger acknowledge,  why am i deciding now future while the present i cant interact with hence i cant use the present to adjust my next likely moves, isnt just being like those who are applying their ideals that where relevant then on now that they have the capability to do so, hence arent we just defeating the purpose of our mission by providing sugar while the now needs could have change into needing salt. 

I have long observered this desync happening when one progress spiritually,  didnt think unrelated could keep getting more en more, en i know im not at epitome yet mostly because i still keep to reason and logic to some extent hence since i examine data it allows me not to be fully into self delusion mode en run in self forfulling circles.
